subject: Need travel decision soon
text:
Hey,

I finally got our travel window confirmed, but the registration closes tonight, so I need your answer urgently. The train leaving at 7:40 gets us there before the first session, while the bus departs earlier, costs slightly more, and gives you extra time to review the schedule. I found one remaining budget room, but it might vanish as soon as I refresh the page, and I cannot risk losing the discounted fare tonight; the link expires soon. If you prefer not to wake at dawn, I can check the afternoon option, though we would miss lunch. The portal also asks for each traveler’s dietary preference, so send me that too. Please reply as soon as possible tonight; I will book both seats together once you answer.
